## Summary

The behaviour that was wrong, and the behaviour that is right now.

## Root cause

Why it was wrong. A fix that only describes the symptom leaves the next occurrence unguarded.

## Regression coverage

The assertion that fails without this change and passes with it, by name. If no test can fail
without it, say that here and say why that is acceptable.

## How it was tested

The commands you ran and what you saw.

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything you would have wanted to know before reading the diff.
